method: Per-criterion similarity s_i in [0,1]. Numeric: s = 1 - min(1, |x - r| / scale). Categorical: 1 if same class, 0.5 if listed as related, else 0. Score = sum(w_i * s_i) / sum(w_i) over INCLUDED criteria. Coverage = sum(w_i included) / sum(w_i all). Criteria with a missing value on either side are excluded, not scored as zero.
confidence_rule: If coverage is below 0.5 the score is marked low confidence.
